data_policy: Wholly synthetic. Extends the foundations fixture set. No real people, employers, records or text.
notes: Eligibility results are EXPECTED LABELS written by hand (evaluated_by fixture-expected-label). No eligibility engine produced them.
claim_e_python_inferred is a labeled example of an inferred claim; no model was run (inferred_by synthetic-inference-label).

Candidate E availability is the sensitive-context case: the source answer is deliberately not represented in any claim, evidence locator, chunk or prompt-bound text. Only an 'unknown' availability claim exists.
Active-status rule has no 'unknown' case pending open decision O1.

chunk_store.store/fixture/chunk_a_profile_old: Synthetic summary from an older profile version.
chunk_store.store/fixture/chunk_b_profile: Synthetic summary: enjoys writing short web articles.
